text_to_speech: there's so many things that I loved about working on Last of Us season one it's just the thing I think about all the time is that I got to have my assistant editor Emily Mendez become my co-editor along outside of me and then also get nominated for an Emmy alongside of me which is incredible in the end of it though the best part about working on the season was that we had this incredible creative collaboration with Craig Mason he's a lovely individual and the thing that I like so much about working with him is that he's not only is he generous with allowing a sort of creative license to come and bring new ideas but he's so wise and smart with when he just decides how to tell us how to do a note decides you know how are we going to you know approach a certain sequence he knows exactly how to talk to us in the way that's you know how editors think [Music]
